title: Legend and Title Lifecycle
intent: Revise legend layout and components, edit chart titles, or remove complete guide-owned resources.
useWhen: Use this recipe after legends or a chart title already exist and need focused layout or content changes.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when semantic encodings should change; edit or remove the encoding instead of restyling its legend.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Revise legend layout and components, edit chart titles, or remove complete guide-owned resources.

steps.instruction: Prepare only the existing legend and title lifecycle state required by the selected focused operation.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable legend and title lifecycle result or workflow.
Choose only the focused legend and title lifecycle components required by the task; mutually exclusive creation alternatives are demonstrated as independent chart variants.
Use the focused lifecycle actions only after their owned legend and title lifecycle resources exist and are uniquely targeted.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Increasing the bottom Canvas margin alone does not move a bottom legend away from an x-axis title.
pitfalls.fix: Give every legend in the row the same position, titlePosition, offset, and itemGap; use an explicit offset that clears the axis title, such as 52 pixels with a 120-pixel bottom margin on a 640 by 400 Canvas.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
